facts.F171: PortFixtureLifetimes matches a service the host builds with a factory forwarding to another registration only through a declared forwarder list naming each service and its forward target: IRepository<Portfolio> to IPortfolioRepository, IReportReader and IReportWriter to ReportRepository. Such a service matches only when the port registers it with a factory too (no implementation type, no instance), with the host's lifetime, and the port registers the forward target with the host's lifetime; the forward target is then compared by what is built like any other registration. A forwarder registered at the port by type or by instance, or one whose forward target the port does not register, is reported. A service type the host registers more than once (every IReportMetric) matches only when the port's implementation type is among the host's registrations of that type; with one host registration the last-registration comparison applies unchanged. What a port factory returns is not observed. The rules live in PortFixtureLifetimes, the one owner of the comparison; the forwarder list is a static member beside StandInsBuiltOnPurpose; the Reality Check and Refinement fixtures register no forwarder and no repeated service type, so all four fixture cases stay green.
